scope: Analytical counterexamples, ideal two-bar component, load-channel and cost budgets. Not a calibrated particle bed, ski trial, reset machine or selected 50 C material.

ski_reference.pair_status: Inherited illustrative project pair. Static groomed-snow literature has broad ranges; this pair is not established as the requested fresh groomed snow target.

post_peak.scope: Constructed comparison curves with identical peak. Neither curve is measured snow or synthetic grain behavior.

arch.modulus_status: hypothetical constitutive parameter, not measured at 50 C
arch.geometry: Two ideal pinned axial bars with fixed end supports. No real hinge geometry, supporting frame or 3D packing modeled.

recovery.scope: Exponential toy memory time window; the two 90% values are design fractions, not probability. No passive recovery guarantee.

integration_status: S1 concept combines normal load bypass, retained shear-triggered movement and mechanical reverse reset. Its complete geometry is not designed; W2 aperture/protection claims do not automatically transfer.
